reddit.title: Introducing Interactive Features in Provincia: When the Colony Talks Back
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest devtalk, which highlights new features designed to make your colony more interactive. From thought badges on settlers to real-time alerts for problems, your settlement will now communicate its needs more effectively. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

steam.title: Provincia: New Interactive Features Unveiled!
steam.body: We're pleased to announce exciting new features in Provincia that enhance the way your colony interacts with you. With thought badges for settlers and a problem-alert system, your settlement will now communicate its needs in real-time. Learn more about these updates in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
